purpose: train-only descriptive domain coverage and matched intervention; no model updates or Recall

coverage.threshold_rule: group-weighted empirical 95th percentile of heldout-synthetic kNN distance
coverage.metric: mean of 5 nearest reference-fit Euclidean distances in reference-fit standardized PCA
limitations: Statistics contain scene, camera and semantic content as well as lighting.
Geographic independence is not established by technical/group-disjoint splitting.
Brightness strata and group weighting do not control all content confounds.
This report cannot authorize a training/Recall search or prove pure style.

summary_populations.gain: enabled recipient channels; grouped by recipient place

interventions.limitation: Equal lambda does not match actual perturbation. Preservation relative to the original Qwen descriptor is not evidence of matched clean-Day place alignment. No loss, optimizer, Recall or automatic gate.

content_review_required: Compare camera/road/scene composition at similar brightness.
DarkDriving technical grouping does not establish independent routes.
Review sampled images and non-overlap outliers before donor experiments.
Distance/brightness/descriptor drift does not prove transferable lighting.
